subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The research team (1)/ consists of specialists (2)/ from economics and statistics (3)/ backgrounds. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **part 3** of the sentence.
 
• The phrase "**specialists from economics and statistics**" is incorrect because it does not follow proper grammatical structure.
 
• To ensure clarity and grammatical correctness, the preposition "**in**" should be used instead of "**from**." 
 
• The correct phrase should be "**specialists in economics and statistics**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The research team consists of specialists in economics and statistics backgrounds."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "The research team"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "****consists of specialists****"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "backgrounds."** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
